lesson_text: STR_944 (OtherCorp+SUE+IVOL) achieves Grade A (49.8, SR 1.429, CAGR 17.6%, MDD 22.8%) with solid OOS retention 0.69. Base signal is PIT-clean: rolling 252d IVOL + date-filtered OtherCorp flow + SUE within 7d window. However, post-hoc overlays contain C9 (DD brake same-day, no t-1 lag) and C5/C11 (old FRED MRS same-month pattern from L-441). The alpha source (PEAD + institutional flow) is economically sound, but overlay metrics are inflated. Must apply DD t-1 lag and replace old MRS with v7.1 regime engine before trusting composite SR. OOS IS/OOS gap (1.596 vs 1.101) suggests moderate overfitting in overlay parameters.
core_reference: Ball & Brown (1968) PEAD; Sias (2004) Institutional herding; QEPM Section 10 statistical defense; L-441 MRS invalidation; L-465~470 overlay parameter re-validation
